# Repository guidance for Copilot

Read and follow the root [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before working in this repository.
It contains the shared engineering expectations and the authoritative file-to-skill mapping.

Open the relevant linked `SKILL.md` and companion guide for the task, including when automatic skill discovery is unavailable.
Keep shared rules in `AGENTS.md` and domain procedures in their skills so this entry point does not drift.
